title: City by practice pages are indexed only with 3 or more upcoming Events or 2 or more active Spaces, and carry Event schema

source.ref: Frequency Launch Build Brief, owner, 2026-10-06; gap report /mnt/project-files/launch/2026-10-06-launch-sweep.md

detail: WORKSTREAM 9 of the launch brief (ADR-1720). TODAY: three local page families gate indexing three different ways and none matches the brief. /discover/cities/[citySlug] uses a density score >= 40 (app/discover/cities/_data.ts:33,66). /discover/places/[citySlug] indexes with 1 Circle or 1 Event (app/discover/places/_data.ts:45,72). /discover/events/in/[city]/[category] indexes with 1 Event (app/discover/events/_data.ts:358). There is no city by practice page, and city pages emit an ItemList of URLs (lib/jsonld.ts:363-380), not schema.org Event nodes. THE FIX: one shared rule (3 upcoming Events or 2 active Spaces) read by the page, robots meta and sitemap; city by practice pages built on it; list pages emit Event nodes for each upcoming Event. Wave 2.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),p=require("path");const r=f=>fs.existsSync(f)?fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8"):"";const walk=(d,o=[])=>{if(!fs.existsSync(d))return o;for(const e of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const q=p.join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory()){if(e.name!=="node_modules")walk(q,o)}else if(/\.(tsx?|mjs|md)$/.test(e.name))o.push(q)}return o};const fail=m=>{console.error(m);process.exit(1)};const ID="LIVE-807";const all=walk("lib").concat(walk("app"));const rule=all.find(f=>/MIN_UPCOMING_EVENTS\s*=\s*3/.test(r(f))&&/MIN_ACTIVE_SPACES\s*=\s*2/.test(r(f)));if(!rule)fail(ID+": no shared index rule (MIN_UPCOMING_EVENTS = 3, MIN_ACTIVE_SPACES = 2)");const mod=rule.replace(/\.tsx?$/,"").replace(/^/,"@/");const readers=all.filter(f=>f!==rule&&r(f).includes(mod));if(!readers.some(f=>/sitemap/.test(f)))fail(ID+": the sitemap does not read the index rule");if(readers.filter(f=>/page\.tsx$/.test(f)).length<2)fail(ID+": fewer than two local page families read the index rule");if(!/@type.{0,4}Event\b/.test(r("lib/jsonld.ts").slice(r("lib/jsonld.ts").indexOf("eventListSchema"))))fail(ID+": city lists still emit no Event nodes")'
verify.note: Fails until one 3-Events-or-2-Spaces rule is read by the sitemap and local pages, and city lists emit Event schema.
